## Setup

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, collapse = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())

## Allow duplicate labels:
options(knitr.duplicate.label = "allow")

# wider output when knit'ing:
if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress")) && !knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  options(width = 110)
}
```

```{r packages_and_functions}
library(data.table)
library(digest)

source("20_functions/source_dir.R")
source_dir("20_functions")
```


## Clear all derived data, checksums, output database, tables and figures, and html-files

```{r clear_all_products}
# Clear all code-derived data and results:
# - use `rm_cache = FALSE` to keep cache of computationally heavy stuff
# - if `rm_checksums = TRUE` new data may be applied because new checksums are 
#   generated in the next chunk which default to the latest REDCap data export.
# clear_all(remove             = TRUE,
#           rm_html            = TRUE,
#           rm_cache           = FALSE,
#           rm_checksums       = TRUE)

# For a completely clear run, use:
clear_all(remove             = TRUE,
          rm_html            = TRUE,
          rm_cache           = TRUE,
          rm_checksums       = TRUE)
```

Generate checksums for data exported from REDCap:
```{r make_checksums}
if(!file.exists("03_checksums") || length(list.files("03_checksums")) < 2) 
  mk_checksums(date = "latest")
```


## Files in `30_process_data` directory

Make overview of `Rmd` that can be processed:
```{r 30_process_data}
DIR <- "30_process_data/"
filenames <- list.files(DIR, pattern="Rmd$")
filenames <- filenames[!grepl("^00|^99", filenames)]

render_multiple_rmd(filenames, path = DIR, params = list(
  import_randomization_list = TRUE,
  rand_list_path = "L:/Auditdata/DEXA-PSYCH Randomiseringsliste/DEXA-PSYCH-Randomization-list.xlsx",
  rand_list_sheet_nm = "Pakkelisten",
  fake_trt_rho = .2))
```

## Files in root

```{r root}
# Only process files in public repo:
git_url <- gert::git_remote_info()$url
in_public_rep <- grepl("DEXA-PSYCH\\.git$", git_url)

if(in_public_rep) {
  filenames <- c("README.Rmd", "CHANGELOG.Rmd")
  stopifnot(all(file.exists(filenames)))
  render_multiple_rmd(filenames, path = ".") 
}
```



## Appendix

```{r mk_fun_appendix_code, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# To easily generate the appendix-lines below, use the following function:
mk_fun_appendix_code <- function(file = "20_functions/run_all_fcts.R", roxygen = TRUE) {
  exprs <- parse("20_functions/run_all_fcts.R", keep.source = TRUE)
  for(e in exprs) {
    funname <- as.character(e[[2]])
    lines <- c("",
               paste0("#### `", funname, "()`"),
               "",
               paste0("```{r ", funname, ", code = get_function_lines(\"20_functions/run_all_fcts.R\", \"", 
                      funname, "\", roxygen = ", roxygen, ")}"),
               "```")
    cat(lines, sep="\n")
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
mk_fun_appendix_code(roxygen = TRUE)
mk_fun_appendix_code(roxygen = FALSE)
```
